title: DEENE MOHD KI BAQA YA HUSSAIN BAS WO TERA AAKHRI SAJDA HUSSAIN
body:
Seena'e Akbar se jo khenchi sina
Hogaya ek khoon ka darya rawa'n
Kaise uthe Laasha'e Kadiyal jawa'n
Tu ne woLaasha bhi uthaya Hussain
<<MINI>>
Ya Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Jang huwi khoon me ghaltaan huwe
Khaakh pa Zainab ke Pisar gir pade
Khaime me jab Dono ke Laashe gaye
Maa ne kiya Shukrka Sajda Hussain
<<MINI>>
Ya Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Dekh ke Naoshah Ka Tukde badan
Bain kare Kis se lipat kar Dulhan
Door Madine me hai Hamsin Bahan
Bewa huwi Fatima Kubra Hussain
<<MINI>>
Ya Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Dafn kiya Tu ne jo apna Pisar
Nanhi si turbat me jigar thaam kar
Asghar e Masoom ki Maa ne magar
Phool sa Sar naize pa dekha Hussain
<<MINI>>
Ya Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Akbar o Asghar bhi fida kardiye
Qasim o Abbas juda hogaye
Deen e Payambar ki baqa ke liye
Tu ne bhare ghar ko lutaya Hussain
<<MINI>>
Ya Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Hazrat e Abbas ke Shaane kate
Zainab o Kulsoom ke Baazu bandhe
Haay wo Pyaason pa kathin marhale
Tauq me Aabid ka gala tha Hussain
<<MINI>>
Ya Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Shimr jo khanjar liye aage badha
Fatima Zehra ki ye aayi Sada
Chhor de Bachcha hai Mera bekhata
Hai ye Muhammad ka Nawasa Hussain
<<MINI>>
Ya Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Deti rahi Fatima Zehra sada
Katgaya lekin Tera Pyaasa gala
Sar Tera naize se bhi Deta raha
Haqq o Sadaqat ki sada Ya Hussain
<<MINI>>
Ya Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Aale Nabi Koocha 0 Bazaar me
Tauq e Giraa'n Gardan e Beemar me
Sar khule phir Shaam ke darbar me
Laayi gayi Saaniye Zehra Hussain
<<MINI>>
Ya Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Shaam ke zindaan ki taarikiya'n
Karti rahi Pyaasi Sakina fugha'n
Sou'n Main kaise Tera Seena kahan
Aaiye jald Aaiye Baba Hussain
<<MINI>>
Ya Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Shimr ne maare hain tamaache Mujhe
Dekhiye rukhsaar hain soojhe huwe
Dard hai kaano me abhi tak Mere
Marti hai ab Teri Sakina Hussain
<<MINI>>
Ya Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Aaj talak hai Tere Gham ka asar
Shaam me Majlis ki bina daal kar
Binte Ali baith Gayi'n khaak par
De diya Majlis ka Saleeqa Hussain
<<MINI>>
Ya Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Ham ko Tere Gham ki Sa'aadat mili
Kitni balandi ki Ibaadat mili
Ek Tere Maatam me ye Izzat mili
Aati hain Majlis me jo Zehra Hussain
<<MINI>>
Ya Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Fatima Zehra ne ye Ehsaan kiya
Hamko Tere Gham ke liye chun liya
Tere Azaadaar ko Rutba mila
Ban gaye Zehra ki Tamanna Hussain
<<MINI>>
Ya Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Ham ko Rasheed Usne sahara diya
Jab bhi masa'eb ne paresha'n kiya
Ham ne tadapte huwe be saakhta
Tute huwe dil se pukara Hussain
<<MINI>>
Ya Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
author: Rasheed Shaheedi
